description:
[measured] Historical rows as CSV, for backtests. dataset: liquidations | funding_settlements
    (since 2024-09) | funding_hourly | open_interest_hourly | hl_positions (Hyperliquid whale
    positions with liquidation prices). start/end are ISO dates (UTC). Without a key or on the free
    tier only the last 24 hours are available; Pro: any 31-day window; Bot: full history. The key
    is read from the MCP connection's X-API-Key header, or pass api_key. limit caps rows here
    (max 5000); for bulk use download_url with the same key.

api_key.description: LiquidVision API key (lv_...). Omit when the key is sent as the X-API-Key header on the connection.
api_key.title: Api Key

dataset.description: Dataset id: liquidations | funding_settlements | funding_hourly | open_interest_hourly | hl_positions | lighter_positions (see list_history_packages).
dataset.title: Dataset

end.description: End of the window, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime, UTC.
end.title: End

exchange.description: Venue id (binance, bybit, okx, bitget, hyperliquid, gate, htx, kucoin, mexc, bingx, aster, kraken, gmx) or 'all' where the tool allows it.
exchange.title: Exchange

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
limit.title: Limit

start.description: Start of the window, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime, UTC.
start.title: Start

symbol.description: Contract as BASEUSDT, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (1000PEPE and kPEPE fold to PEPEUSDT).
symbol.title: Symbol

name: get_history
title: History
